title: docs: give the @objectstack/skills install line for the project's own package manager
body:
Fixes #24926
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Three `content/docs/**` pages printed `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"` as the only install command. Each one now gives the install line for the project's own package manager, in the same shape as PR #24922 (`content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx` step 1):

- the pnpm line in the block;
- a one-line comment with the npm and yarn spellings;
- the rule "add the package with the manager that installed the project", followed by the npm failure as measured.

| site | old → new | measurement |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `content/docs/upgrading.mdx`, step 4, the "From 17.x to 18" block | `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"` → `pnpm add -D "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"`, plus the line `#   npm: npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@…"   ·   yarn: yarn add -D "@objectstack/skills@…"`, plus the rule sentence | M1 pnpm exit 0 · M2 the old line exit 1 · M3 npm exit 0 · M4 yarn exit 0 |
| `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx`, § Installing skills | same change | M1 to M4 |
| `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`, § Installing skills, step 1 | same change. Also: the 17.x refusal now names pnpm's `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION` beside npm's `ETARGET`, and the 18.0.0-next.0 note runs `npx skills list` before `npx skills remove --all` | M1 to M4, M5, M6 |
| `skills/README.md` (≈`:11`) | **not in this PR.** The file is governed (Tier H, `domain:skills`). The `domain:devx` seat moves it to a `domain:skills` card when this one lands | — |
| `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` (≈`:129`) | **not in this PR**, for the same reason | — |

`upgrading.mdx` already said to run `npx skills list` before `--all` ("Run `npx skills list` first"), so that sentence is unchanged. `skills.mdx` does not print `--all`.

## Measured

Node 22.22.0. Each scaffold was created in its own new, empty directory under the session scratchpad. The command was copied from the page: the pnpm line, or a spelling from the comment with its `@…` filled in with the same version expression.

| # | manager | project | command | exit | `@objectstack/skills` line in `package.json` afterwards |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| M1 | pnpm 10.28.0 | `create-objectstack@18.0.0` scaffold, pnpm-installed | `pnpm add -D "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"`, the line every site now keeps | `0` | `"18.0.0"`, written in place of the template's `"^18.0.0"` |
| M2 | npm 10.9.4 | a second `create-objectstack@18.0.0` scaffold, pnpm-installed | `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"`, the line every site kept | `1` | not written: `npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')`; `package.json` unchanged (`"^18.0.0"`) |
| M3 | npm 10.9.4 | `create-objectstack@18.0.0` scaffold, npm-installed. pnpm was taken off `PATH`, so the scaffolder chose npm and wrote `package-lock.json` | `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"`, the comment's npm spelling | `0`, **it succeeds** | `"^18.0.0"`: npm saves with its default `^` prefix, so the value is the template's |
| M4 | yarn 1.22.22 | `create-objectstack@18.0.0 --skip-install`, then `yarn install` (exit `0`, `yarn.lock`) | `yarn add -D "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"`, the comment's yarn spelling | `0` | `"18.0.0"` |
| M5 | pnpm 10.28.0 | `create-objectstack@17.7.0 --skip-skills`, pnpm-installed (`@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0) | `pnpm add -D "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"` | `1` | not written: `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION  No matching version found for @objectstack/skills@17.7.0`; unchanged |
| M6 | npm 10.9.4 | the M3 scaffold, with the version given as the literal `17.7.0` | `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@17.7.0"` | `1` | not written: `npm error code ETARGET`, `No matching version found for @objectstack/skills@17.7.0.`; unchanged |

Notes on the readings:

- **M6 used a literal version.** No npm-installed 17.7.0 scaffold could be built here: `create-objectstack@17.7.0`'s own `npm install` exited `1` with the same `edgesOut` error, and again on a retry. So npm's 17.x refusal was measured with the version written out.
- **Yarn's 17.x refusal** was also measured: `error Couldn't find any versions for "@objectstack/skills" that matches "17.7.0"`, exit `1`. The page does not name it.
- **pnpm, npm and yarn all re-sorted `dependencies` alphabetically** in M1, M3 and M4. No other value changed.

## Gates

Local, at head `bd085862fc`. These are the 44 commands that `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives from this diff, with each exit code captured before any pipe.

- **All 44 exited `0`.**
- **Five needed a build first.** They answered exit `3` (prerequisite not met) on the first pass, which is not a measurement:
  - `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture` and `check:docs-transcript-drift` needed `@objectstack/lint` built;
  - `@objectstack/spec check:docs` needed its generated tree;
  - `@objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` needed `@objectstack/client-react` built.

  I built `@objectstack/lint...` and `@objectstack/client-react...` under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0` both times) and re-ran the five. Each exited `0`.
- **The builds left the worktree clean.** `git status --porcelain` printed nothing afterwards.
- **`--ran` reconciliation:** `44 derived, 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (it calls this "a DERIVED zero").
- **Selected verdict lines:**
  - `check:doc-anchors`: 563 internal fragment links, each reaching a real heading;
  - `check:docs-single-h1`: 418 pages, no body-level heading-one;
  - `check:docs-image-tag`: OK, 9 concrete pins against 18.0.0;
  - `check:skill-docs`: `✓ content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`, "Skill docs in sync";
  - `check:nul-bytes`: OK, no raw control bytes.
- **No package code changed,** so there is no package build, `pnpm test` or `typecheck` to run. `test:repo` is left to CI.
- **Merge check:** `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` exited `0` against `origin/main` `693352e4c2`. That is three commits past the base, none of them under `content/docs/`.

## Changeset

This PR is labelled `skip-changeset`, because `content/docs/**` ships in no package. Measured:

- no published package lists a `content` or `docs` path in its `files[]`;
- no build step copies these pages into a package;
- after the build, I searched every path `@objectstack/spec` ships (`dist`, `json-schema`, `liveness`, `prompts`, `llms.txt`, `README.md`, `api-surface`) for five strings from the edited passages. Each matched 0 files. The positive control `defineStack` matched 93 files.

## Acceptance notes

- **One sentence beyond the install line, the rule and `npx skills list`.** In `skills-reference.mdx`, the 17.x refusal sentence now names the code that step 1 prints. Left alone, the page would put npm's `ETARGET` under a pnpm command, which prints `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION` (M5).
- **A sentence left as written.** `skills-reference.mdx` still says that a bare `npm install --save-dev @objectstack/skills` installs whichever version the registry tags `latest`. That is true as stated, and equally true of a bare `pnpm add -D`. The card rules out other prose changes, so it stays. Carrier: none.
- **A sixth site the card does not list.** `packages/skills/README.md:28`, the published `@objectstack/skills` README, prints the same `npm install --save-dev` line as its only step 1. That is the M2 command. The README is in the package's `files[]`, so this text is on the npm page and in the tarball. It is outside this PR's file surface, and changing it publishes (a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/skills`). It is reported to the seat to join the follow-up card with the two `skills/**` rows.
- **`create-objectstack@17.7.0` cannot install with npm here.** Its own `npm install` (npm 10.9.4, no lockfile) exits `1` with `edgesOut`. 17.7.0 is a superseded release, and 18.0.0's npm path succeeds (M3). Carrier: none.
- **pnpm and yarn write the exact version; npm writes a caret range.** pnpm and yarn write `"18.0.0"` and npm writes `"^18.0.0"`. None of the three pages says which. The sentence in `releases/v18/18-0.mdx`, "The command writes the exact version", is about its pnpm line, and M1 agrees with it.
